description_sq:
Vile individuale te Secret Garden per shitje!
Ne nje nga rezidencat me te mira te zones se TEG, ofrojme vile individuale 4-kateshe per shitje. Me siperfaqe ndertimi prej 500 m2, e vendosur ne nje parcele prej 342 m2, vila eshte e organizuar si me poshte:
Kati -1: 210 m2, sallon ndenjie, palester, hobby room, hapesire relaksi (sauna, jacuzzi), tualet, magazine, depo teknike, lavanderi
Kati 0: 98 m2, sallon ndenjie, kuzhine, depo, tualet
Kati 1: 98 m2, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete
Kati 2: 94.5 m2, 1 dhome gjumi matrimoniale, 1 garderobe, 1 tualet, 1 verande
Vila eshte ne faze punimesh, duke ofruar mundesine e pershtatjes sipas nevojave te klientit. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor sii dhe nje projekt te detajuar arredimi.
Per me shume informacion jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni!
description_en: Individual villas in Secret Garden for sale! In one of the best residences in the TEG area, we offer individual 4-storey villas for sale. With a construction area of 500 m2, located on a plot of 342 m2, the villa is organized as follows: Floor -1: 210 m2, living room, gym, hobby room, relaxation area (sauna, jacuzzi), toilet, warehouse, technical storage, laundry Floor 0: 98 m2, living room, kitchen, storage, toilet Floor 1: 98 m2, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms 2nd floor: 94.5 m2, 1 double bedroom, 1 wardrobe, 1 bathroom, 1 veranda The villa is under construction, offering the possibility of adaptation according to the client's needs. It has regular mortgage documentation and a detailed furnishing project. For more information, please contact us!
